backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as a placeholder for future backend functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features for updating CSS color properties from white to black text in light theme mode across index.css and tailwind.config.js.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files describing their purpose, functionality, and key features including theme support, animations, and component responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including semantic tokens for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and component colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with basic meta tags, title, and root div mounting the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping the application with ThemeProvider and rendering all major sections including Header, CustomCursor, MouseLightEffect, and page sections.
frontend/src/components/CallToAction.tsx: Call-to-action section with scroll animations featuring Discord join button, server launch notice, and glassmorphism card styling with theme-aware colors.
frontend/src/components/CloudsBackground: Empty file placeholder for previously removed CloudsBackground component.
frontend/src/components/CustomCursor.tsx: Custom cursor component with morphism-inspired design that detects touch devices, tracks mouse position, and responds to hover/click states with animated size changes.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying server IP, Discord link, copyright information, and caffeine.ai attribution with responsive grid layout and theme-aware styling.
Gameplay features section with scroll-triggered animations displaying four feature cards explaining Lifesteal mechanics including combat, hearts, competition, and strategy.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed navigation header with logo, desktop/mobile menus, theme toggle, and Discord link. Includes smooth scrolling to page sections and responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero landing section with animated title reveal, server IP copy button, magnetic Discord button with ripple effects, and smooth scroll animations.
frontend/src/components/IntroSequence.ts: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/MouseLightEffect: Creates a radial gradient light effect that follows the mouse cursor, disabled in light theme mode, using RAF for performance.
frontend/src/components/RewardsSection.t: Displays server rewards (top player, seasonal events) and statistics (active players, hearts, battles) with scroll-triggered fade-in animations.
Shop section showcasing premium items and crate keys with pricing, includes Discord contact notice for purchases.
frontend/src/components/SiteLogo.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Toggle button switching between light/dark themes with animated sun/moon icons and accessible keyboard controls.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: React context provider managing theme state (light/dark), persisting to localStorage, and applying theme classes to document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook managing Internet Identity authentication and creating backend actors, with query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file for future React Query hooks when backend functionality is implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: React hook using IntersectionObserver to trigger visibility state when an element scrolls into view with configurable threshold and root margin.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark purple theme color system using OKLCH color space, light/dark mode variants, gradient backgrounds, custom cursor disabled on touch devices, and scroll animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point wrapping the App with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider for state management and authentication.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme with OKLCH-based purple color system, glassmorphism shadows, custom border radius variables, display/mono fonts, and animation keyframes for accordion and other UI effects.
project_state.json: Project metadata for HellCod MC Minecraft Lifesteal server website featuring glassmorphism design, animated intro sequence, server info display (hellcod.ddns.net:19100), Discord integration, and premium animations with mobile-responsive layout.
